贪心+二分O(nlogn)的LIS做法。存一个数组记录长度为i的LIS中结尾最小.en: Greedy + binary search O(nlogn) LIS method. Keep an array to record the smallest number at the end of the LIS of length i, and a number can be quickly added to the array through binary search. Greedy gives that the array index is the LIS length. According to Dilworth's theorem, the minimum number of non-decreasing subsequences the sequence can be divided into is equal to the length of the longest decreasing subsequence.
